Soldiers from across the 10th Mountain Division, conducted a 3-mile ruck march to their destination, and spent a night out in the field during the, Alpine Operations Course, on Fort Drum, New York, Oct. 26, 2023.

 Soldiers used the skills they learned in the course to transport equipment and personnel across ravines and water.
